description: Configure the scraper with eBay item URLs, store URLs, store category URLs, and/or plain keyword searches.

marketplace.description: Which eBay country site to use for searchQueries. Ignored for startUrls entries, which use whatever domain is already in the URL.
marketplace.title: eBay Marketplace

maxItems.description: Maximum number of items to scrape. Applies mainly to store/category/search pages.
maxItems.title: Max Items

proxy.description: Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxy is required — eBay's bot protection redirects every datacenter IP to a captcha page. Keep the default RESIDENTIAL prefill unless you have a trusted alternative.
proxy.title: Proxy configuration

searchQueries.description: Plain keyword searches — no need to construct a URL. Each keyword is searched on the selected marketplace. Optional if startUrls is provided instead.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

startUrls.description: List of eBay URLs to scrape. Supports individual item pages (/itm/), search result pages (/sch/), category pages (/b/), and seller store pages (/str/). Optional if searchQueries is provided instead.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: eBay Item & Store Scraper Input
